upstream_sync.policy: semantic adoption of Robert C. Martin Clean Architecture and Musk's five-step method; prior-art candidates compared across skills.sh and SkillsMP

intent.job_to_be_done: Answer layered-architecture, dependency-direction, technology-selection, and over-engineering questions with a four-layer model, dependency rule, user-stack mapping, anti-over-engineering check, and GEB fractal documentation discipline so architecture decisions persist in code.
target_users: developers refactoring monoliths or layered code
teams evaluating microservices / Kafka / Redis / caching
engineers migrating between data stores or API styles
reviewers judging dependency direction and adapter boundaries
inputs: code snippets with suspected layering or dependency violations
outputs: framework-to-layer mapping for the user's stack
minimal code example with layer labels
anti-over-engineering verdict via Musk's five steps
L2/L3 documentation skeletons for major architecture decisions (GEB fractal discipline)
framework-agnostic dependency-violation detection via L3 INPUT audit
exclusions: cache-library choice between Redis and Memcached
framework mechanism debugging and SQL tuning

defaults.attribution: Inspired by Robert C. Martin's Clean Architecture and the upstream repositories listed in upstream_inspiration
